notes.made: Egan wrote it about Stevie Nicks and produced it with Lindsey Buckingham and Richard Dashut. Buckingham plays guitars and sings backing vocals, Nicks sings backing vocals, with Annie McLoone, John Selk and Tom Moncrieff, and Stephen Hague is on keyboards with Mike Huey on drums.
notes.context: Columbia put it out in March 1978, while Rumours was still everywhere, and it reached 8 on the Hot 100 over 22 weeks. It was Egan's biggest hit. It's on the Boogie Nights soundtrack (1997), and it turned up again in This Is 40.

listen_for.note: Nicks and Buckingham on the backing vocals, so for three minutes this is half of Fleetwood Mac singing about Nicks behind a man who had a crush on her.
Buckingham plays guitar on it as well as co-producing.

leads_to.title: Dreams
leads_to.why: Nicks's own song from the same circle, a No. 1 in June 1977 written at the Record Plant in Sausalito.

notes.unverified: Wikipedia's page for the album Not Shy wasn't found, so the album name rests on the song page.
